the Vakufix system is superior to the Sterivap system in terms of efficiency.

the Vakufix vacuum pump is more suitable for use in bone-vacuum techniques than the Sterivap vacuum pump.

the performance of vacuum pumps used for the cementing technique with bone-vacuum.
the use of vacuum pumps for the evacuation of the femoral medullary canal during implantation of cemented total hip prostheses.
the use of a bone-vacuum technique for cementing hip prostheses.

the vacuum pump should be chosen according to the system used and the experience of the surgeon.

the Vakufix system is the most suitable system for bone-vacuum assisted cementing.

the Vakufix system provides a reliable, simple and effective method of evacuating the medullary cavity during cemented total hip replacement.
